lead_headline: AI SDK turns 44 commits into a disciplined infrastructure day
lead_body: The backport pipeline absorbed the most sustained work — race conditions patched, trigger hardened from pull_request_target to pull_request.labeled, helpful error surfaces added. Features landed in parallel: Anthropic's advisor tool, Google embedding fileData support, DeepSeek reasoning_effort enum, and a new konsistent-provider package to standardize third-party conventions.
lead_article:
The headline today belongs to AI SDK, which logged 44 commits across a day of genuine infrastructure density. The backport pipeline received the most sustained attention — race conditions patched, `pull_request_target` replaced with the safer `pull_request.labeled` trigger, and a helpful error surface added for workflow-file edits in backport PRs. Substantive features landed alongside the plumbing: Anthropic's new advisor tool shipped, Google embedding gained `fileData` support, DeepSeek's provider now accepts adaptive thinking and the full `reasoning_effort` enum, and a new `konsistent-provider` package arrived to standardize conventions across third-party provider packages. The Mistral fix forwarding `stopSequences` as a native stop parameter and gateway retry support rounding out the functional changes. Busy, disciplined day.

Everywhere else, the pace was measured. Astro's eleven commits were mostly supply-chain hardening — SHA-pinned actions, OIDC token theft mitigations in the preview-release workflow, caching stripped from the release path — with two functional fixes slipping in: named HTML entities for attribute escaping and a widened TypeScript peer range for the Svelte adapter. Hydrogen merged the `cartGetDefault` cartId fix and cut a release PR. Metaflow opened three PRs, the most pointed being the S3 guard against empty input in `_put_many_files` and `_read_many_files`. Gemma.cpp merged the enum-to-string utility. Claude Code shipped v2.1.140 — changelog-only — against a backdrop of 30-plus user issues, several serious: silent Opus billing despite Sonnet configuration, the `/goal` hook declaring completion with tasks still pending, and the WebSearch tool wrapping queued messages inside `<system-reminder>`. Those three in particular are worth watching.
